senses.en: a false move made to deceive an opponent

example.en: The boxer made a feint with his left hand before striking.
example.zh: 拳击手出拳前用左手虚晃了一下。

senses.en: to make a false move in order to deceive

example.en: The forward feinted to pass, then shot at the goal.
example.zh: 前锋假装传球，然后射门。

senses.en: extremely serious or terrible

example.en: The flood left thousands of families in dire conditions.
example.zh: 洪水使成千上万的家庭陷入极糟的境况。

senses.en: the time between sunrise and sunset, when it is light

example.en: The store is open during the daytime only.
example.zh: 这家商店只在白天营业。

senses.en: a student training to be an officer at a military or police academy

example.en: The young cadet rose early every morning for drills.
example.zh: 这名年轻学员每天早起操练。

senses.en: the branch of mathematics that deals with collecting, analyzing, and interpreting numerical data

example.en: She studied statistics at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习统计学。

senses.en: numerical facts or measurements collected and analyzed

example.en: The latest statistics show a rise in online sales.
example.zh: 最新统计数据显示网上销售额有所上升。

senses.en: a formal written agreement between countries or sovereign states

example.en: The two sides are working on a peace treaty.
example.zh: 双方正在拟定一项和平条约。

senses.en: including all or nearly all aspects of something

example.en: The report gives a comprehensive overview of the city's public services.
example.zh: 该报告全面概述了该市的公共服务。

senses.en: a comprehensive school in the UK

example.en: She attended the local comprehensive before going to university.
example.zh: 她上大学前就读于当地的一所综合中学。

senses.en: a kitchen appliance that is closed and used for baking or roasting food

example.en: She put the cake in the oven.
example.zh: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。

senses.en: the space between two intersecting lines or surfaces, measured in degrees

example.en: Draw a triangle and measure each angle.
example.zh: 画一个三角形并测量每个角。

senses.en: a particular way of looking at or presenting something

example.en: The article takes a fresh angle on the issue.
example.zh: 这篇文章从新的角度来看待这个问题。

senses.en: to move or direct something at a slant, not straight

example.en: She angled the mirror to see behind her.
example.zh: 她把镜子斜转过来以便看到身后。

senses.en: so strong or powerful that it is difficult to resist or deny
senses.zh: 压倒性的；强大得难以抵抗的

example.en: The evidence against him was overwhelming.
example.zh: 对他不利的证据是压倒性的。

senses.en: very great in amount, degree, or effect

example.en: She felt an overwhelming urge to laugh.
example.zh: 她感到一阵难以抑制的想笑的冲动。

senses.en: an agreement to marry; the period between this agreement and the wedding

example.en: They announced their engagement last month.
example.zh: 他们上个月宣布了订婚。

senses.en: an arrangement or appointment to meet someone or do something

example.en: She has a business engagement at noon.
example.zh: 她中午有一个商务约见。

senses.en: involvement or participation in an activity, or emotional connection
senses.zh: 参与；投入；（对工作的）投入感

example.en: Employee engagement has improved this year.
example.zh: 今年员工的参与度有所提升。

senses.en: a battle or fight between military forces

example.en: The two armies fought a fierce engagement.
example.zh: 两军进行了一场激烈的交战。

senses.en: to show that something is true or likely; to be a sign of something

example.en: The survey indicates strong support for the plan.
example.zh: 调查显示人们强烈支持该计划。

senses.en: to point to or show a place, direction, or thing

example.en: The arrow indicates the exit.
example.zh: 箭头指示出口。

senses.en: to state or suggest something in a brief or indirect way

example.en: He indicated his willingness to help.
example.zh: 他表示愿意帮忙。

senses.en: to cause physical pain or injury to someone or something

example.en: I hurt my knee while playing football.
example.zh: 我踢足球时伤了膝盖。

senses.en: to make someone feel unhappy or upset

example.en: His unkind words hurt her feelings.
example.zh: 他不友善的话伤害了她的感情。

senses.en: injured, especially physically

example.en: Two players were hurt in the match.
example.zh: 两名球员在比赛中受了伤。

senses.en: emotional pain or suffering

example.en: The hurt in her voice was clear.
example.zh: 她声音中的痛苦很明显。

senses.en: a polite or formal word for a woman
senses.zh: 女士；对女性的礼貌称呼

example.en: A lady at the counter asked for directions.
example.zh: 柜台前的一位女士询问方向。

senses.en: a woman with good manners and refined behavior
senses.zh: 淑女；举止优雅、有教养的女士

example.en: She behaved like a true lady throughout the dinner.
example.zh: 整个晚宴期间，她表现得像一位真正的淑女。

senses.en: British: a title used before the name of a noblewoman or the wife of a lord
senses.zh: （英国）夫人；用于贵族女性或勋爵夫人姓名前的头衔

example.en: Lady Eleanor greeted the guests at the door.
example.zh: 埃莉诺夫人站在门口迎接宾客。

senses.en: a building where objects of scientific, historical, or artistic interest are collected and shown to the public

example.en: We visited the city museum on Sunday.
example.zh: 我们周日参观了市博物馆。

senses.en: a long period of history with a particular character or starting point
senses.zh: 具有某种特征或从某一固定时点开始的历史时期；时代，纪元

example.en: The invention of the internet opened a new era in communication.
example.zh: 互联网的发明开启了通信的新时代。

senses.en: a major division of geological time, usually divided into periods
senses.zh: 地质年代的主要划分单位，通常分为多个纪

example.en: The Mesozoic era is divided into three periods.
example.zh: 中生代分为三个时期。

senses.en: a cutting tool with two blades joined at a pivot

example.en: I used a pair of scissors to cut the paper.
example.zh: 我用剪刀把纸剪开了。

senses.en: a wrestling hold in which the legs are wrapped around an opponent's body or head and squeezed
senses.zh: 剪刀腿；夹腿摔（摔跤招式）

example.en: He trapped his opponent in a scissors hold.
example.zh: 他用剪刀腿夹住了对手。

senses.en: a set of straps for holding a person or animal, or for attaching something to the body

example.en: Make sure your safety harness is secure before climbing.
example.zh: 攀爬前务必确认你的安全吊带系牢。

senses.en: leather straps fitted to a horse or other draft animal so it can pull a cart

example.en: The horse was wearing a leather harness.
example.zh: 那匹马戴着皮革挽具。

senses.en: to use something, such as natural energy, to produce power or achieve a goal

example.en: The village harnesses the power of the wind to make electricity.
example.zh: 这个村庄利用风力发电。

senses.en: to put a harness on a person or animal, or to attach it to something

example.en: They harnessed the horses to the cart.
example.zh: 他们把马套到马车上。

collocations: harness a horse to a cart

senses.en: great hurry; excessive speed that may lead to carelessness

example.en: In his haste to leave, he forgot his keys.
example.zh: 他匆忙离开时忘了带钥匙。

senses.en: providing extra or backup support

example.en: The ship has an auxiliary engine for emergencies.
example.zh: 这艘船有一台应急用的备用发动机。

senses.en: a person or thing that gives help or support

example.en: The clinic trained several auxiliaries to support its medical staff.
example.zh: 这家诊所培训了几名辅助人员，为医护人员提供支持。

senses.en: a verb such as be, do, or have used with a main verb

example.en: In the sentence 'She is running', 'is' is an auxiliary.
example.zh: 在句子“She is running”中，“is”是助动词。

senses.en: in private; without other people knowing or being present

example.en: She spoke to him privately after the meeting.
example.zh: 会后她私下跟他谈了话。

senses.en: by a private person or company rather than the government
senses.zh: 由私人或民营机构（出资、拥有等）

example.en: The airline is privately owned.
example.zh: 这家航空公司是私人拥有的。

senses.en: a solid piece of material with flat sides

example.en: The toy set includes colorful wooden blocks.
example.zh: 这套玩具包括彩色的木块。

senses.en: an area of a city surrounded by streets

example.en: She lives just two blocks from the station.
example.zh: 她住在离车站仅两个街区的地方。

senses.en: to stop something from moving, passing, or happening

example.en: A fallen tree blocked the road for hours.
example.zh: 一棵倒下的树把路堵了好几个小时。

senses.en: a formal game or contest between two players or teams

example.en: We watched a football match last night.
example.zh: 我们昨晚看了一场足球比赛。

senses.en: a thin stick of wood or cardboard that produces fire when struck

example.en: She lit the candle with a match.
example.zh: 她用一根火柴点燃了蜡烛。

senses.en: to be equal to, suit, or correspond with something

example.en: Your shoes match your dress perfectly.
example.zh: 你的鞋子和裙子非常相配。

senses.en: a person able to compete or equal with another

example.en: He finally found a worthy match in the tournament.
example.zh: 他在锦标赛中终于找到了一位强劲的对手。

senses.en: a common English surname

example.en: Mr. Harris works at the local library.
example.zh: 哈里斯先生在当地的图书馆工作。

senses.en: a region on the Isle of Lewis and Harris in the Outer Hebrides of Scotland
senses.zh: 哈里斯（苏格兰外赫布里底群岛的地区）

example.en: They spent a week hiking across Harris and Lewis.
example.zh: 他们在哈里斯和刘易斯岛上徒步了一周。

senses.en: causing harm or damage

example.en: Smoking has a deleterious effect on health.
example.zh: 吸烟对健康有有害影响。

senses.en: a word or phrase that becomes fashionable, often in business or technology

example.en: "Synergy" is a buzzword often heard in corporate meetings.
example.zh: “协同效应”是公司会议上常听到的流行词。

senses.en: having or showing a desire for revenge

example.en: He filed the lawsuit out of a vindictive desire for revenge.
example.zh: 他出于报复心提起了诉讼。

senses.en: easily shaped or bent, especially of metal

example.en: Gold is a highly malleable metal.
example.zh: 黄金是一种延展性极高的金属。

senses.en: easily influenced or changed

example.en: Young minds are often described as malleable.
example.zh: 年轻人的思想常被形容为可塑性强的。

senses.en: the quality of being brief; shortness

example.en: The brevity of his speech impressed the audience.
example.zh: 他演讲的简短给听众留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: restricting freedom of movement or action

example.en: He found his office job too confining and wanted to travel.
example.zh: 他觉得办公室工作太受束缚，想去旅行。

senses.en: crowded or narrow in space

example.en: The submarine's confining corridors made some crew members uneasy.
example.zh: 潜艇里狭窄的通道让一些船员感到不安。

senses.en: to fall behind or move away from a group

example.en: Some tired hikers straggled behind the rest of the group.
example.zh: 一些疲惫的远足者掉队落在队伍后面。

senses.en: to spread out in an irregular or scattered way

example.en: Old houses straggled along both sides of the road.
example.zh: 老房子杂乱地分布在道路两旁。

senses.en: the bar used to steer a bicycle or motorcycle

example.en: He gripped the handlebars tightly as he rode downhill.
example.zh: 他下坡时紧紧握住车把。

senses.en: the sport of jumping into water in a graceful way, or swimming underwater

example.en: She won a gold medal in diving at the competition.
example.zh: 她在比赛中赢得了跳水金牌。

senses.en: a hard crust that forms over a healing wound

example.en: Don't pick at the scab, or the cut may take longer to heal.
example.zh: 别去抠痂，否则伤口愈合会更慢。

senses.en: (disapproving) a worker who continues working during a strike
senses.zh: 工贼；罢工期间顶替上班的人

example.en: Union members called the new hires scabs.
example.zh: 工会成员把新雇的工人称作工贼。

senses.en: to form a scab; (informal) to work during a strike
senses.zh: 结痂；（罢工期间）顶替上班

example.en: The wound scabbed over within a few days.
example.zh: 伤口几天内就结了痂。

senses.en: a knitted sweater that opens and fastens down the front with buttons or a zipper

example.en: She wore a wool cardigan over her blouse.
example.zh: 她在衬衫外面穿了一件羊毛开衫。

senses.en: serving as an example to explain or clarify something

example.en: She gave an illustrative case to explain the rule.
example.zh: 她举了一个例子来说明这条规则。

senses.en: to notice sounds with your ears

example.en: I could hear rain on the roof.
example.zh: 我能听见屋顶上的雨声。

senses.en: to receive information or news

example.en: We heard that the shop will close.
example.zh: 我们听说那家店要关门了。

senses.en: to listen to someone or something carefully

example.en: Please hear me out before you decide.
example.zh: 请在决定前听我把话说完。

senses.en: to listen to facts in a court case

example.en: The court will hear the case next month.
example.zh: 法院将于下个月审理此案。

senses.en: a strip or tube of pasta, often used in soups or stir-fries

example.en: She added fresh noodles to the hot broth.
example.zh: 她把新鲜面条加入热汤里。

senses.en: to play or improvise casually on a musical instrument

example.en: He noodled on the piano while waiting.
example.zh: 他等待时随意弹着钢琴。

senses.en: to think about or consider something in a casual way

example.en: We noodled over a few ideas for the project.
example.zh: 我们随意琢磨了几个项目想法。

senses.en: space or a place where things can be kept

example.en: We need more storage in the kitchen.
example.zh: 我们厨房需要更多储物空间。

senses.en: the act or process of keeping something for future use

example.en: Proper storage keeps food fresh longer.
example.zh: 妥善储存能让食物保鲜更久。

senses.en: computer memory used for saving data

example.en: This phone has plenty of storage for photos.
example.zh: 这部手机有大量存储空间存照片。

senses.en: a table used for writing or working, often with drawers
senses.zh: 供书写或办公用的桌子，通常带抽屉

example.en: She left the papers on her desk.
example.zh: 她把文件留在书桌上。

senses.en: a counter or office where a service is provided
senses.zh: 提供服务的工作台或办公室

example.en: Please ask at the front desk.
example.zh: 请到前台询问。

senses.en: the loud noise heard after lightning

example.en: A loud clap of thunder woke the children.
example.zh: 一声响雷把孩子们吵醒了。

senses.en: to make a loud rumbling noise like thunder

example.en: The trucks thundered along the narrow road.
example.zh: 卡车沿着狭窄的道路隆隆驶过。

senses.en: to speak or shout very loudly and angrily

example.en: He thundered at the players to get back in position.
example.zh: 他怒吼着让球员们回到位置。

senses.en: the best work ever produced by an artist, writer, or craftsman

example.en: The novel is considered her masterpiece.
example.zh: 这部小说被认为是她的代表作。

senses.en: an outstanding achievement of great skill

example.en: The chef's new dish is a culinary masterpiece.
example.zh: 这位厨师的新菜堪称烹饪杰作。

senses.en: to become thicker or denser

example.en: The sauce will thicken as it simmers.
example.zh: 酱汁炖煮时会变浓稠。

senses.en: to make something thicker or denser

example.en: Add flour to thicken the soup.
example.zh: 加面粉使汤变稠。

senses.en: a condition or disadvantage that makes success or progress difficult

example.en: Lack of experience was a big handicap in her new job.
example.zh: 缺乏经验是她新工作中的一大不利条件。

senses.en: a physical or mental disability

example.en: He lives an active life despite his handicap.
example.zh: 尽管有残疾，他依然过着积极的生活。

senses.en: to make it harder for someone to do something

example.en: The team was handicapped by injuries all season.
example.zh: 整个赛季该队都因伤病而处于不利状态。

senses.en: a weight or advantage given to a weaker competitor to equalize chances in a race or game

example.en: His golf handicap was reduced after the tournament.
example.zh: 这次比赛后，他的高尔夫差点降低了。

senses.en: relating to or characteristic of a large city

example.en: She enjoys the fast pace of metropolitan life.
example.zh: 她喜欢大都市生活的快节奏。

senses.en: a person who lives in a metropolis

example.en: As a metropolitan, he is used to crowded subways.
example.zh: 作为大都市居民，他习惯了拥挤的地铁。

senses.en: in the Eastern Orthodox Church, a bishop ranking between an archbishop and a patriarch

example.en: The metropolitan led the service at the cathedral.
example.zh: 都主教在大教堂主持了礼拜。

senses.en: a picture or drawing in a book, article, etc. that explains or decorates the text

example.en: The children's book has beautiful illustrations on every page.
example.zh: 这本儿童书每一页都有精美的插图。

senses.en: an example that makes an idea easier to understand

example.en: He gave a clear illustration of how the new system works.
example.zh: 他清楚地例证了新系统是如何运作的。

senses.en: the strip of wood or stone at the bottom of a doorway; the entrance to a house

example.en: She paused for a moment on the threshold before knocking.
example.zh: 她在门口停顿了一下，然后敲门。

senses.en: the level at which something starts to happen or have an effect

example.en: The pain threshold differs from person to person.
example.zh: 疼痛阈值因人而异。

senses.en: the point at which something new begins

example.en: The country stands on the threshold of major economic reform.
example.zh: 这个国家正站在重大经济改革的起点上。

collocations: on the threshold of a new era

senses.en: a tree with winged seeds, whose leaves turn bright red or orange in autumn

example.en: The maple in our yard turns bright red every October.
example.zh: 我们院子里的枫树每年十月都会变成鲜红色。

senses.en: the wood of the maple tree, used for furniture and flooring

example.en: The kitchen cabinets are made of solid maple.
example.zh: 厨房橱柜是实心枫木做的。

senses.en: syrup made from the sap of the maple tree

example.en: She poured maple syrup over her pancakes.
example.zh: 她在煎饼上倒了枫糖浆。

senses.en: under or below something

example.en: The cat hid underneath the bed.
example.zh: 猫躲在床底下。

senses.en: on the lower side; below

example.en: She wore a warm coat with a sweater underneath.
example.zh: 她穿了一件暖和的外套，里面还套着毛衣。

senses.en: a long poem or story about a hero's great deeds

example.en: The Odyssey is a famous ancient Greek epic.
example.zh: 《奥德赛》是著名的古希腊史诗。

senses.en: very impressive or grand in scale

example.en: They set out on an epic journey across the mountains.
example.zh: 他们踏上了穿越群山的壮丽旅程。

senses.en: a large room or hall where an audience sits to watch performances or listen to speeches

example.en: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
example.zh: 毕业典礼在学校礼堂举行。

senses.en: a strong liking or habit for something

example.en: He has a penchant for collecting old maps.
example.zh: 他有收集旧地图的爱好。

senses.en: not limited by any conditions; absolute

example.en: Parents should give their children unconditional love.
example.zh: 父母应该给孩子无条件的爱。

senses.en: a state of extreme happiness and excitement

example.en: She was in a state of exaltation after winning the prize.
example.zh: 获奖后她欣喜若狂。

senses.en: the act of raising someone to a higher rank or position

example.en: His exaltation to the board surprised no one.
example.zh: 他被提升进董事会没有人感到意外。

senses.en: a strong fear of small, enclosed spaces

example.en: Her claustrophobia makes elevators difficult for her.
example.zh: 幽闭恐怖症让她很难乘坐电梯。

senses.en: to charm or deceive someone, often in a pleasant way

example.en: She beguiled the audience with her stories.
example.zh: 她用故事迷住了观众。

senses.en: a faint design in paper, visible when held up to the light

example.en: Hold the banknote up to the light to see the watermark.
example.zh: 把钞票对着光看就能看到水印。

senses.en: a line showing the level reached by water

example.en: The old watermark on the bridge showed how high the flood had risen.
example.zh: 桥上的旧水位线显示出洪水涨到了多高。

senses.en: to mark paper or files with a watermark

example.en: The company watermarks every document it publishes.
example.zh: 该公司给发布的每份文件都加上水印。

senses.en: lacking courage; cowardly

example.en: His craven refusal to speak up disappointed his friends.
example.zh: 他怯懦地拒绝发声，令朋友们失望。

senses.en: a coward

example.en: They called him a craven for backing out.
example.zh: 他们因为他临阵退缩而骂他是懦夫。

senses.en: the departure of a large number of people at the same time
senses.zh: 大批离去；（有组织的）大撤离

example.en: There was an exodus of residents from the city before the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨来临前，大批居民撤离了城市。

senses.en: the second book of the Bible, about the Israelites leaving Egypt

example.en: The story of the Exodus is central to Jewish tradition.
example.zh: 《出埃及记》的故事是犹太传统的核心。

senses.en: to settle or make certain something, such as a deal or victory
senses.zh: 敲定；最终赢得；确定（交易、胜利等）

example.en: The team clinched the championship with a late goal.
example.zh: 凭借终场前的进球，球队锁定了冠军。

senses.en: in boxing, holding the opponent to prevent punches

example.en: The two fighters fell into a clinch in the corner.
example.zh: 两名拳手在角落里缠抱在一起。

senses.en: a unit for measuring the energy value of food

example.en: This snack contains about 200 calories.
example.zh: 这份零食大约含有200卡路里。

senses.en: continued effort to do something despite difficulties

example.en: Her perseverance helped her finish the marathon despite the injury.
example.zh: 尽管受伤，她的毅力帮助她跑完了马拉松。

senses.en: understood or agreed without being stated directly

example.en: There was a tacit agreement that neither would mention the incident.
example.zh: 双方心照不宣，都不提那件事。

senses.en: still in existence; not lost or destroyed

example.en: Only a few copies of the original manuscript are still extant.
example.zh: 原稿只有少数几份尚存于世。

senses.en: the act of freeing someone from control or restriction

example.en: The emancipation of slaves was a landmark in history.
example.zh: 奴隶的解放是历史上的一个里程碑。

senses.en: an earlier event or cause

example.en: Researchers studied the antecedents of the crisis.
example.zh: 研究人员研究了这场危机的前因。

senses.en: a word or phrase that a pronoun refers back to

example.en: In "Tom lost his keys," "Tom" is the antecedent of "his."
example.zh: 在“Tom lost his keys”中，“Tom”是“his”的先行词。

senses.en: coming earlier in time or order

example.en: The antecedent events led to the war.
example.zh: 先前的事件导致了这场战争。

senses.en: of a building, having many floors and elevators; very tall

example.en: They live in a high-rise apartment building downtown.
example.zh: 他们住在市中心的一栋高层公寓楼里。

senses.en: a tall building with many floors, used for offices or apartments

example.en: A new high-rise is going up next to the park.
example.zh: 公园旁边正在建一座新高楼。

senses.en: plural of penny: small copper-colored coins of low value

example.en: She collected the pennies from her purse.
example.zh: 她从钱包里收起那些分币。
